examples.arabic: منى بتشتري هدوم جديدة لعرايس نورا.
examples.english: Mona buys new clothes for Nora's dolls.
examples.transliteration: Mona beteshtari hedoom gedida le 3arayes Nora.

examples.arabic: انا رحت المول عشان اشتري هدوم جديده
examples.english: I went to the mall to buy new clothes.
examples.transliteration: Ana roht el mall ashan ashtary hedoom gededa

examples.arabic: انا رحت اشتري هدوم جديده امبارح
examples.english: I went to buy new clothes yesterday.
examples.transliteration: Ana roht eshtery hedoom gedeeda embareh.

examples.arabic: هو ضحك وقال ايامه كانت كل هدوم الكورة ابيض او اسود
examples.english: He laughed and said in his days all football clothes were white or black.
examples.transliteration: howa dehek wa aal ayamo kanet kol hedoom el kora abyad aw eswed

examples.arabic: احمد راح المحل عشان يشتري هدوم
examples.english: Ahmed went to the shop to buy clothes.
examples.transliteration: ahmed raah el mahal ashan yeshtery hedoom

examples.arabic: امبارح انا رحت مع عيلتي عشان نشتري هدوم
examples.english: Yesterday I went with my family to buy clothes.
examples.transliteration: embareh ana roht ma eilety ashan neshtry hodoom
